The gate's own header prices the bundle as a category ("loaded WHOLE into customer agent context windows … paid again in every customer session"), and the ruling it enforces (2026-08-21, 「10402 需要整体考虑 skills 的长度,不能为了一个小功能扩写很多。」) is about the bundle, not one filename — so 37% shipping unpriced is the gate lagging its own charter, and closing that is invariant-restoration, not a new policy. Scope, honouring counter-argument 1: extend the token ratchet to the HAND-AUTHORED bundle population (`rules/**`, `evals/**`, hand-authored references/contracts), ceilings initialized at current measured values, shrink-only, same enumeration discipline (a discovered file with no ceiling reds); GENERATED files (the 9 `_index.md`, `react-blocks.*`) are excluded with the generator named as the reason IN the gate header — a ceiling on a generated file reds on regeneration, the wrong actor. If the authored/generated boundary turns out not to be mechanically derivable from the tree, the implementer stops and reports — the #9923/#9962 document-the-boundary fallback is then the honest exit, not a silent partial extension. Gate-population design ⇒ tier priced at claim time per the lane's standing rules.
